bullets.text: Apple Pay Under Fire - A £1.5 billion lawsuit claims **Apple**'s control over Apple Pay harms UK consumers.
App Store Ads Expansion - Starting March, **Apple** will show multiple ads in App Store search results.
Google Photos Memes - **Google** Photos introduces a new feature to create memes using personal images.
AI Headlines in Google Discover - **Google** Discover retains AI-generated headlines due to user engagement.
Satechi's USB-C Hub Review - The 7-in-1 hub enhances connectivity for **Apple** devices with MagSafe.
Apple's AI Skepticism - **Apple**'s Craig Federighi rejected an AI feature for iPhone home screens.
Anker Power Bank Review - The **Anker** MagGo power bank impresses with its compact design and LED display.
Waymo Under Investigation - The **NTSB** probes **Waymo** for illegal school bus behavior by its robotaxis.
TikTok's Ownership Changes - The **TikTok USDS** Joint Venture LLC is formed, altering the app's management.
Microsoft Assists FBI - **Microsoft** provided BitLocker keys to the FBI to unlock suspects' laptops.
